sch: Bulk historical import (analyst: Jim Totime), source: 'Guia do Campeonato 1997/98' (A Bola), scanned by club -- doc1 (roster/bio table, printed ahead of the 1997-98 season) + doc2 (headshots + each player's season-by-club career table), 18 clubs, 2 scans each.
